products.title: Bias-Cut Slip Dress
products.body_html: Fluid silk satin cut on the true bias to skim the silhouette with French seams and delicate spaghetti straps.

products.title: Cashmere Rib Crew
products.body_html: Thick seven-gauge ribbed cashmere sweater with saddle shoulders and snug crew neckline.

products.title: Cashmere Scarf
products.body_html: Pure featherweight cashmere woven on antique shuttle looms with hand-twisted fringe.

products.title: Cigarette Trouser
products.body_html: Slim, tapered tailoring in crisp wool-crepe with pressed crease, slash pockets and ankle-bone crop.

products.title: Cocoon Cardigan Coat
products.body_html: Boiled wool knit with shawl collar, dropped shoulders and clean seam pockets. Substantial outerwear cardigan.

products.title: Column Knit Dress
products.body_html: Ribbed wool-silk blend knit following a lean, tubular line with ankle-grazing hem and gentle side split.

products.title: Cropped Tailored Jacket
products.body_html: Compact wool tailored with clean structured shoulders, cropped waistband and hidden single horn button closure.

products.title: Doppio Trench
products.body_html: Water-repellent double-cotton gabardine tailored with horn buttons, storm flap and deep back inverted vent.

products.title: Fine Merino Turtleneck
products.body_html: Extra-fine 18-gauge merino wool with seamless circular-knit collar and ribbed cuffs. Lightweight essential layering piece.

products.title: Hand-Framed Cotton Polo
products.body_html: Long-staple cotton knitted on a hand-frame machine, finished with three corozo buttons and a flat knit collar. The knit softens with wear and recovers with washing.

products.title: Leather Belt
products.body_html: Single-layer vegetable-tanned bridle leather with unpolished solid brass buckle. Develops a warm patina with wear.

products.title: Nove Blazer
products.body_html: The signature tailoring cut of the house. Medium-weight virgin wool with a natural shoulder, single button closure and high peaked lapels. Hand-basted floating canvas chest piece that gently moulds to the wearer over time.

products.title: Oversized Alpaca Knit
products.body_html: Chunky-knit alpaca with a dropped shoulder and cropped boxy torso. Offered in two sizes: Size 1 and Size 2. Designed to layer over a crisp column shirt.

products.title: Pleated Midi Skirt
products.body_html: Heat-set knife pleats in lightweight wool, finished with a narrow waistband and concealed side fastening. Mid-calf hemline.

products.title: Pleated Wide Trouser
products.body_html: Two inverted pleats falling from a high waistband. Cool wool blended with four percent elastane to hold the crease through seated wear. Unhemmed cuff, ready to be tailored to the shoe.

products.title: Poplin Column Shirt
products.body_html: 120-count cotton poplin with a straight, unpleated body falling below the hip. Semi-spread soft collar and concealed front placket.

products.title: Quilted Silk Liner
products.body_html: Washed silk filled with recycled down, quilted in four-centimetre channels. Designed to button inside the Serra Coat or to be worn alone over fine knitwear.

products.title: Serra Coat
products.body_html: Double-faced wool and cashmere, woven in Biella and tailored without lining for an effortless drape from the shoulder. Raglan sleeves and an unpleated waist let the volume shape itself in motion. Double-breasted closure with matching self-belt.

products.title: Silk Charmeuse Blouse
products.body_html: Heavy silk charmeuse with fluid drape, concealed button placket and elongated cuffs.

products.title: Silk Twill Square
products.body_html: Hand-rolled 90x90cm mulberry silk twill square printed with minimalist geometric composition.

products.title: Striped Cotton Shirt
products.body_html: Crisp poplin with hairline Bengal stripes, mother-of-pearl buttons and tailored French cuffs.

products.title: Structured Tote
products.body_html: Full-grain calfskin tote with reinforced structural base, internal slip pocket and twin carry handles.

products.title: Wool Waistcoat
products.body_html: Tailored suiting vest in virgin wool with silk lining and adjustable back cinch buckle.

products.title: Wrap Wool Skirt
products.body_html: Asymmetric wrap skirt in structured flannel with concealed horn button closure and side drape.
